text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was quite the eventful
summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Plan A is in motion...
All that's left is to prepare
for the Kikuka Sho. If I do say so
myself, my time management skills are
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's almost an entirely different person
from how she was before summer camp.
While I'm happy for
her newfound
enthusiasm, I can't help but worry..

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, guinea pig! Let's give the Classics
our all!

unanswered. With our sights on the
